lines.text: Peter will always remind them of these things, and thinks it right to refresh their memory while he lives in the tent of his body.
Peter knows his tent will soon be laid aside, as the elders in Jerusalem made clear to him.
Peter says they were eyewitnesses of Christ's majesty, when the voice from the Majestic Glory called Him God's beloved Son.
They heard the voice from heaven on the holy mountain, and Peter says to heed the prophets like a trumpet sounding over a city.

wrong_details.wrong: a trumpet sounding over a city
wrong_details.true: a lamp shining in a dark place

lines.text: No prophecy of Scripture comes from one's own interpretation, because men spoke from God as the Holy Spirit carried them along.
